Isaiah 12:2-3.title: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid; For GOD the LORD is my strength and song; And He is become my salvation.’
Therefore with joy shall ye draw water Out of the wells of salvation.

Psalms 3:9.title: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
Psalms 3:9.text: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD; Thy blessing be upon Thy people. Selah

Psalms 46:12.title: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
Psalms 46:12.text: The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our high tower. Selah

Psalms 84:13.title: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
Psalms 84:13.text: O LORD of hosts, happy is the man that trusteth in Thee.

Psalms 20:10.title: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
Psalms 20:10.text: Save, LORD; Let the King answer us in the day that we call.

Esther 8:16.title: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
Esther 8:16.text: The Jews had light and gladness, and joy and honour.

Psalms 116:13.title: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
Psalms 116:13.text: I will lift up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the LORD.

community.title: Sefaria Community Translation
text: ...Behold, my salvation is He. I will trust and not fear. My strength and melody towards Ya"h HaShem, He has become my salvation.
...And you'll withdraw waters in joy from the wellsprings of the salvation.
...HaShem's salvation upon Your People Your blessing, Selah:
...HaShem of Hosts is with us, secure refuge of ours, the God of Yaakov, Selah.
...HaShem of Hosts, happy is the man who trusts in You.
...HaShem save! The King answer on the day we call.
...For the Jews was light, happiness, gladness, and notoriousness.
...Cup of salvations I will lift and I will call in the name of HaShem
Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates the fruit of the vine.
Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates varied spices.
Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates the lights of the fire.

Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who distinguishes between the holy and the profane, between light and darkness, between Israel and the nations, between the seventh day and the six working days. Blessed are You, O Lord, who distinguishes between the holy and the profane.
